title: 🔥周期估值底已显著抬升
body: 市场处于长线筑底周期。MVRV报1.23，高于上轮同期（2022-09）的0.92。虽然现价较200日定投成本偏离-11.8%，但估值底并未跌回前轮深渊。这说明长线筹码支撑更强，市场底位正在抬高。当前优于历史79%的时间，具备极高的定投盈亏比。偏多。反转信号何时确立？
title_en: 🔥 The Cycle Valuation Floor Has Clearly Lifted
body_en: The market is in a long-term bottoming phase. MVRV sits at 1.23, higher than the 0.92 recorded at this point in the last cycle (Sept '22). Despite current price trading -11.8% below the 200-day DCA cost, the valuation floor hasn't retraced to the abyss of the previous cycle. This signals stronger support from long-term holders—the market base is rising. Current metrics are better than 79% of history, offering an exceptional risk-reward ratio for DCA. Bullish bias. When will the reversal signal be confirmed?
